Pending Applications

Overview

A pending zoning application is an application that has been submitted to Planning & Inspections, but a decision has not been rendered by the appropriate board. 

The public is invited to attend. Meetings are regularly held at the Lincoln County Administration Building.


353 N Generals Blvd. 
Lincolnton, NC 28092
Meetings begin at 6:30 pm


*Historic Preservation Commission meetings are held at 4:00 pm, 3rd floor conference room at 115 W Main Street on the 3rd Thursday of each month. 

For more information, contact Planning & Inspections at (704) 736-8440.

Zoning cases are split into Quasi-Judicial and Legislative, with different rules and procedures applying to each. A simplified guide to the differences in the cases is available in the link below. Please read before planning to speak at a public hearing.

Simplified guide to the differences between Quasi-Judicial and Legislative zoning cases.

The Board of Commissioners and Planning Board hear all legislative cases jointly.

Quasi-Judicial Cases

The Board of County Commissioners hears all quasi-judicial cases, except variances and appeals, which the Board of Adjustment hears. 

**Discussion with board members before the hearing is not permitted.**
